name: vorte
description: Vorte is a Cloudflare-based zero-knowledge cloud service with an offline-first Progressive Web App client for entrepreneurs and organizations in Finland.

scripts.optimize: npm run optimize:fonts && npm run optimize:images
scripts.build: npm run build:appLoader && npm run build:mainScripts && npm run build:serviceWorker
scripts.start: npm install && npm run optimize && npm run dev
scripts.deploy: npm run optimize && npx wrangler deploy
